spec.title: Forecast Rain
spec.description: Watering is skipped only when BOTH dashed limits are exceeded: rain probability ≥ red line AND forecast rainfall ≥ orange line. Limits track the Gist config.

import "date"

data = from(bucket: "irrigation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "irrigation" and r._field == "pump_runtime_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)

starts = data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: date.sub(d: duration(v: int(v: r._value) * 1000000000), from: r._time),
      _value: float(v: r._value) / 60.0,
      _measurement: r._measurement,
      _field: "runtime_min"
  }))

ends = data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: 0.0,
      _measurement: r._measurement,
      _field: "runtime_min"
  }))

union(tables: [starts, ends])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "irrigation" and r._field == "battery_v")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

pumpRuns = from(bucket: "irrigation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "irrigation" and r._field == "pump_runtime_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)

skipEvents = from(bucket: "irrigation")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "irrigation" and r._field == "skip_reason")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "not_time" and r._value != "none" and r._value != "already_watered")

union(tables: [pumpRuns, skipEvents])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", _field: "Event", _value: "Value"})
